item.title: Birdwatchers from overseas travelling to Kerry to see rare redhead duck
item.description: Birdwatchers from across the UK and further afield are travelling to Kerry to see an exceptionally rare redhead duck from North America. This female redhead was first seen on Saturday in Cromane, and she remains there today. It’s the first time this rare duck has been spotted in Kerry, and it’s only been spotted twice in Ireland. item.title: West Kerry school unveils new “Hannah’s Lodge” sensory pod
item.description: A West Kerry school has unveiled a new sensory pod. Scoil Bhreac Chluain in Annascaul purchased the pod after a fundraising drive by two local mothers. Ceara D Treacy and Bríd Lyne, in association with Kerry Mental Health Association, raised over €14,000 through their Hyrox challenge. Advertisement The pod, named “Hannah’s Lodge” is designed to provide a calm, safe and stimulating environment tailored to the individual needs of pupils. item.title: Calls for immediate financial supports for fishermen following swingeing fish quota cuts
item.description: A Kerry county councillor wants immediate financial supports for fishermen following swingeing cuts to Ireland's fish quota. In December, it was announced that the EU's AgriFish Council (Council of Agriculture and Fisheries Ministers) had approved a dramatic reduction of Ireland’s total allowable catches for the most important commercial fish stock, and the scrapping of the Hague Preference. item.title: 34,000 passengers to pass through Cork Airport over St Bridgid’s bank holiday weekend
item.description: 34,000 passengers are expected to pass through Cork Airport this St Brigid’s bank holiday weekend. Passengers travelling over the long weekend are advised to arrive at the airport at least 90 minutes before departure. The Airport says that there has been a strong start to 2026 with high demand for ski and sun destinations. Advertisement It says three new routes will be added to their summer schedule this year, with flights to Nice (France), Santiago de Compostela (Spain) and Antalya (Türkiye).

item.title: Aki Given 6 Week Ban
item.description: Bundee Aki has been suspended for six weeks for verbal abuse towards match officials. The Connacht centre was cited following his side’s URC defeat to Leinster last Saturday and appeared before a disciplinary panel yesterday. The suspension means Aki will miss the opening three games of Ireland’s Six Nations campaign. item.title: Over 700 new homes were completed in Kerry during 2025
item.description: Over 700 new homes were completed in Kerry last year. That’s according to the latest figures from the Central Statistics Office. It shows nationally more than 36,000 new homes were completed in 2025, a 20% rise in a year. Advertisement The CSO report shows that 727 new dwellings were completed in Kerry during 2025. item.title: Kerry workers advised they may be entitled to public holiday entitlements
item.description: Workers in Kerry are being advised that they may be entitled to public holiday pay. Citizens Information say full-time and part time employees could be eligible for the benefit payment or time in lieu. It says part-time and seasonal workers can qualify, when they have worked a total of 40 hours in the previous five weeks. Advertisement This could include a paid day off on bank holidays, an additional leave day, an additional day’s pay, or a paid day off within a month of a public holiday. Eithne
